scope: Texture texel storage from actual route resources and their graph allocation. Excludes driver padding, buffers, drawable pool, pipelines and size-independent scene assets. Simulator function only.

ordinary_transition.ownership: Old ring is GPU-complete before preparation. One replacement ring is prepared, then published, then old handles drop.

recovery_refit.ownership: Lost host ring plus old and new candidate rings during refit. Candidate old ring drops after refit. Lost host ring drops on publication.

repeated_identical_extent.evidence: steady-extent.json and native GPU resource handle equality assertions. Revision is a ring publication witness, not a global GPU allocation counter.

limits: Ownership bounds count app-held target rings, not total driver residency or recovery device memory. Ordinary resize retains scene/presenter pipelines, asset selection and contribution bindings. C07 history reset is forwarded in ContributionFrame. Completion polling stays off UIKit.
